description: SIMULATED AI-inferred competitor strategies. Hypotheses, not facts; evidence chain cites public sources.

rows.inferred_strategy_statement: Defend IL-23 leadership in 1L IBD with H2H data (SEQUENCE vs ustekinumab, REVAMP vs vedolizumab) and close the SC-induction convenience gap (AFFIRM).
rows.strategic_pillars: H2H superiority; convenience; breadth of label

evidence_chain.observation: SEQUENCE: superior endoscopic remission vs ustekinumab
evidence_chain.inference: Uses H2H to claim efficacy leadership

evidence_chain.observation: REVAMP (NCT06880744): RZB vs vedolizumab in targeted-therapy-naive UC
75% in-play capture among IL-23s in front-line IBD

rows.alternative_hypotheses: Focus on psoriasis-to-IBD portfolio bundling; pricing/contracting as main lever
rows.leading_indicators_to_watch: REVAMP readout (~2027); FDA decision on SC induction; contracting announcements
